[[File:Gungan_glyphs.jpg|thumb|250px|Bongo graphics using Gungan glyphs]]
A set of complex '''glyphs''' was used by the [[Gungan/Legends|Gungans]], a [[Species/Legends|species]] of [[Sentience/Legends|sapient]] [[Amphibian/Legends|amphibians]] from [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]], to write their language. The control panel of the Gungan [[Tribubble bongo/Legends|tribubble bongo]] displayed graphics using that writing system.
